<b>Choristors</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are disciples of [[the Choir]], cowled behind white veils and proficient in using their pins with [[Silk]].<ref>Choristor [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Disciple of the Choir, elevated above other pilgrims, and forced to cowl their face forever more. Their use of a pin shows hard training. Their use of Silk, unfurled from a spool held close, shows skill far beyond standard bugs."</i></ref>
== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Choristors either patrol the Choral Chambers or start off lifeless and get reanimated with Silk as soon as Hornet approaches.<br>
Choristors hop back and forth between attacks to retreat or advance, attacking once they are in range with any of the following attacks:
* <b>Delay Slash:</b> Performs a large outwards slash with their pin, waits a moment, then performs another slash. The slashes can be jumped over and they can be counterattacked during the openings easily, especially with [[Needle-bounce]]s.
* <b>Pinwheel Leap:</b> Jumps up and spins midair with their pin, creating a circular hitbox around them, then slams their pin down as they land.
* <b>Silk Whip:</b> Silk whirls around them before they throw their pin out like a harpoon, then whip it upwards back towards themself by the Silk, covering a large area. If Hornet is hit by any part of the whip, the Choristor flurries Silk all around themself, dealing {{Damage|1+1}}.

When defeated, they may drop a small spool of [[Silk]] that Hornet can hit twice to restore up to two strands of Silk.

They can easily be defeated by simply jumping over their Delay Slash and hitting them during their pauses; jumping backwards whenever they perform either of the other two moves works as well.<br>
Hitting them with ranged attacks is most effective. Jumping over the Silk Whip and immediately doing basic slashes or Needle-bounces is also effective.

A Choristor with only 5 HP can be found on the northeastern edge of the [[Whispering Vaults]]. [[Garmond and Zaza]] can be seen quickly defeating said Choristor as soon as they appear on screen.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-threaded]] Choristors have their health doubled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|Void attacks]], but cannot perform Silk Whip and do not drop Silk spools.

* Waver not! Wither not!
* All must gather! All must sing!

== Location ==
Choristors can be found in the [[Choral Chambers]], on the bridge connecting it to [[the Slab]], and in the [[Whispering Vaults]]. They also appear during the [[Enemy Gauntlets (Silksong)/High Halls 1|enemy gauntlet]] in [[the Forum]].
